messages:
Alexa: Planning quiet-window deploy 2024-04-02 02:00 UTC touching API, runtime, console, router. Need pins + rollback criteria before lock.

Ben: Ack. Which runtime build? kernel-v2-quant or kernel-v2-qat?

Carla: Proposal: canary steps 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m soak each. Router header split required.

DeployBot: Deploy queued by Alexa: deploybot/quiet-window/2024-04-02T02:00Z. Runbook: preflight -> canary -> promote.

Dinesh: Note: kernel-v2-qat changed KV eviction heuristics. Recommend pinning config to avoid thrash.

Eva: Console adds optional "session_id" to /v1/sessions (non-breaking). Can router handle unknown fields? I'll run a quick integration.

Ben: runtime pinned: kernel-v2-qat-20240401. API pinned: v2.3.1 for header routing.

Carla: Router rule for canary: header X-Release-Tag == "canary-2042" -> runtime kernel-v2-qat-20240401. API gateway will inject header for 5%.

Dinesh: Runtime config to add:
kv.max_entries=3000000
eviction_policy=lru
eviction_guard=true
Please include in pinned runtime config.

Frank: Rollback triggers:
- 5xx > 1% for 10m
- p95 +40ms for 10m
- OOMs/pod restarts >1 per node in 5m
On trigger: immediate traffic cut to previous variants + page SRE.

Eva: Staging router accepts unknown fields; console change safe.

Carla: Release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/456 with monitoring links.

Alexa: Pin commit (pushing now): api=v2.3.1, runtime=kernel-v2-qat-20240401, console=v1.8.0, router=v3.4.2, runtime_config="kv.max_entries=3000000,eviction_policy=lru". Commit: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/0f4a2b

Ben: Dashboards updated: p95/p99, 5xx, KV hit-rate. Links in PR.

DeployBot: Preflight passed. Integration tests queued (~8m).

Frank: Console UI feature flag set off-by-default behind ff/release-2042 until 25% step.

Alexa: If no holds, change window goes ahead tomorrow. Will post final pin & schedule in #deploy-notifications. :thumbsup:

Carla: No blockers. We'll monitor canary channel. :rocket:
